notes: L1 and L2 oracle: scip-dart 1.7.0 (tier A, Dart SDK 3.13.4, calibration/oracles/scip-dart), one index per package of eight pure-Dart packages (felangel/bloc bloc-v9.2.1 packages bloc, bloc_test, bloc_concurrency; dart-lang/http http-v1.5.0 pkgs http, http_parser, http2, web_socket_channel, http_multi_server), scored with -scip-defs, measured as cloned after `dart pub get` inside each package. universal-ctags 6.2.1 has no Dart parser, so no tier-B oracle exists; the packages that need the Flutter SDK (flutter_bloc, angular_bloc, cupertino_http, cronet_http, ok_http) are not measured, nor are hydrated_bloc and replay_bloc, whose workspace example depends on it.

L1: 2,064 SCIP definitions and 2,064 fathom definitions in the kind intersection, 2,063 matched (sym_recall and sym_precision .9995, kind_agreement 1, range_agreement 1 on all 2,063, every one of 1,731 callables signed). The two misses: web_socket_channel's `signKey` (a comment between the signature and its `=>` body breaks the sibling adjacency the query relies on) and http's library-private extension type `_IterableHeaders` (scip-dart writes a private definition as a local symbol of unspecified kind, which is not read as a definition). scip:namespace (29) is a file or an `import ... as p` prefix and has no fathom symbol. A private member is a `local N` symbol in scip-dart; its kind says what it is, so a private field, accessor, method or variable is read as a definition (SCIPDefs) and a call inside a private method belongs to it (SCIPOptions.PrivateMembers).

L2: 3,131 call pairs in the truth, 3,122 found (call_recall .9971), 3,236 fathom pairs, 3,122 in the truth (call_precision .9648). 295 callable references are left out of the truth because no call is written at their range (a tear-off such as `onError: c.addError`, an operator, the super(...) of an initializer). The dialect's pairs outside the index are calls through a function-typed parameter or field (`emit(state)`, `handler(e)`, `onError(...)`), which are call sites in the source and references to a parameter in the index.

L3 (wave lc, fathom 99c3c7d3, F-D: LB-F74, LB-F75): file_edge_recall .3534 (422 of 1,194 SCIP file edges) and file_edge_precision .9953 (422 of 424), from .108 and .9847 against fresh scip-dart 1.7.0 indexes of the same eight packages (dart pub get, calibration/oracles/scip-dart): a type reference (extends, with, implements, a field's, parameter's or return type, a type argument) and a prefixed name (`p.Thing`) are file-resolved edges, and an import through a barrel (package:bloc/bloc.dart's `export 'src/...'`, with show and hide) binds the file defining each name; bloc/packages/bloc reads 76 of 219 where it read 0. import_resolution stays the thin 6 of 6 (O244). L4: def_mapping .9995, typed_recall .8464 vs .85 (a reference to a parameter or a type parameter)
